You're quite a livewire today.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: I'm glad you picked up on that!

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: I've felt like my entries

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: have started to become a little stale,

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: so I've been thinking about various new ways I can make an entrance.
Is breaking windows not dramatic enough already?

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: The fact that you're even asking is a clear indication that there's a problem.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Sometimes you really need some pizazz.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Y'know, a bit of the ol' razzle dazzle!

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: So, I've come up with something.
What is it?

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Next time we go on a mission,

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: I'll enter while spinning in circles dramatically,

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: all while screaming,

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Heroic entrance!

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: at the top of my lungs.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: That's where I'll need your help.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: While I'm shouting,

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: you'll have to push a button for me.
What happens then?

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Hahaha!

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: The explosives I've buried beforehand will detonate,

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: and then the real fireworks will begin.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: A superhero, walking epically through the fire!

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Just imagine, me striding along, backlit by the towering flames filling the area.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: How amazing would that be?
... Laplace.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Yes?
Why would you want to cause even more havoc at the scene of an accident?

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: You may have a point.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: That might be why Maxwell rejected it.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Okay, how about we ditch the explosives and go for actual fireworks instead of metaphorical ones?
I suggest you scrap it and think of something else.
